name: amo-visual-designer
title_zh: 蓝金双色自动合规的法国房产社媒图
tagline_zh: 给 AMO Invest 做 Instagram/Facebook 图，自动套用蓝金主色和房产法条标注。
tagline_en: Auto-styled IG/FB posts for AMO Invest: brand colors, DPE/Hoguet legal labels baked in. No more manual compliance.
desc_en: Directeur artistique / infographiste spécialisé pour AMO Invest (Graveson, 13690). Génère des visuels professionnels et RÉALISTES (posts Instagram/Facebook, stories, carrousels, flyers, encarts, print) alignés sur la charte AMO Invest (bleu marine #2E358D, or #E9CA31, logo clé-maison), respectant les obligations légales immobilières françaises (DPE/GES, honoraires, loi Hoguet/ALUR). why_zh: 把艺术指导和法务合规焊进同一套模板，输出即终稿，省掉设计后的人工法务校对。
why_en: Art direction and French real-estate law fused into one template pipeline. Output is final—no separate legal review pass.
limit_zh: 只认 AMO Invest 的蓝金双色与 logo；只做法国房产类图，其他行业或品牌色需重训。文本内容需自备。
limit_en: Only AMO Invest's navy/gold & logo. French real-estate only; other sectors/brands need retraining. You supply copy; no text generation.
title_en: French real-estate social visuals in brand blue & gold.
